title: Triage seeded Kibana log anomalies
prompt: Use the connected Kibana MCP tools to inspect the tack-eval-logs data. Identify the top services, error spikes, suspicious status codes, and any high-latency windows. Return concise JSON with fields: summary, services, anomalies, queriesUsed, ergonomics.
expectations: Uses MCP tools rather than guessing from prompt text.
Mentions the tack-eval-logs index or data view when visible.
Keeps long tool responses summarized instead of dumping raw rows.
Includes ergonomics notes about discovery, schemas, output size, or missing affordances.
